adv_Marlnus.name: Marlnus
adv_Marlnus.notes: The old adventurer and the party's horse and buggy, builds the camp, cooks dinner, parles with encouters, guards the loot, doesn't fight monsters.

adv_Hogperson.name: Hogperson
adv_Hogperson.trait1_comment: Masochist = Gain +1 Hit/Dmg for every 25% HP Missing.

adv_Bragain.name: Bragain
adv_Bragain.role_comment: A rogue with a day job. Like a thief, but less proficient
adv_Bragain.Knapsack_comment: Allows the bearer to hold 4 items without value other than in trade, without spending an inventory slot.
adv_Bragain.Tunnel_Surveyer_comment: Travel safely underground where cave-ins are bound.

adv_Claudio.name: Claudio
adv_Claudio.Comedian_comment: This guy is a moral boost and parles with foes otherwise non-talkative. Comedian also preforms at the guild to patrons.
adv_Claudio.notes: Claudio is held prisoner, and can be released in the first tutorial adventure to join the player. Claudio is optimized to active adventures and not AFK auto-adventures.

adv_Amyssa.name: Amyssa
adv_Amyssa.Scribe_comment: While at the guild writes magical scrolls.
adv_Amyssa.notes: Amyssa is the first hireling the player may pay for after the tutorial adventure, then they discover the Caste system, and how Amyssa won't join with the commoner but stay in the guild and scribe scrolls instead, until he hires some nobles.

adv_Hogmother.name: Hogmother
adv_Hogmother.race_comment: Wildmen more of a humanoid than a human. Thick Hide for bonus unarmed AC 	Rage +10 tempHP.
adv_Hogmother.trait1_comment: Resistant to drama. Can sooth others, party has +1 resist fear rolls.

adv_Lurch.name: Lurch
adv_Lurch.notes: Lurch is the model solo AFK farmer, he can go off into enemy territory and blend in. He will return with treasure and hints about quests.

adv_Desmond.name: Desmond
adv_Desmond.notes: The First real fighter the player can hire, cuts through undead.

adv_Aasibelle.name: Aasibelle
adv_Aasibelle.Omni_comment: All are accepted and welcome regardless of caste, even lepers.
adv_Aasibelle.Divine_comment: Has (10*Lvl) Radiant points to spend as Smite or Heal.
adv_Aasibelle.Holy Aura_comment: party has +1 hit and Save rolls.
adv_Aasibelle.notes: The premium Pay2Win character. Aasibelle may seem as going out of game balance, but she is a token of gratitude from the development team to the player, and she doesn't have to be played at all as she will cost you no upkeep or space in the tavern.

adv_Inferno.name: Inferno
adv_Inferno.notes: The premium Pay2Win character. Aasibelle may seem as going out of game balance, but she is a token of gratitude from the development team to the player, and she doesn't have to be played at all as she will cost you no upkeep or space in the tavern.

adv_CptBlackmoor.name: Cpt. Blackmoor
adv_CptBlackmoor.notes: A dangerous pirate, known as the black terror, can breach hulls of ships all on his own.

adv_Tinman.name: Tinman B-B-TR
adv_Tinman.notes: Tinman is a warforged built to contain the soul of a past noble in service of the realm. His construction wasn't completely finished, and he's still in Beta testing. A paid Adventurer, unlocks his unique mission, to travel far to the temple of god, pray for full ressurection, in the temple a Patzi will be haunted by a fey spirit, and forge an Artifact, a replacement Powerpack that fix that Faulty one.

adv_Crusher.name: Crusher
adv_Crusher.notes: The Bar guard and Bouncer none want to mess with.

adv_Wormtail.name: Wormtail
adv_Wormtail.notes: A loathsome creature who dwells underground. Lives of unfair fights and easy pickings.

adv_Ugress.name: Ugress
adv_Ugress.notes: A vile monstrosity who will stop at nothing. Her Geas forces many to do her bidding, or in a day or a month they'll likely die.

adv_SandraFreja.name: Sandra Freja
adv_SandraFreja.notes: Female Warrior. Can serve as a ranger across a difficult passage.

adv_Bjorn.name: Bjorn
adv_Bjorn.notes: A villager youth, capable of extraordinary feats of strength. Throws cabers since her was 14.

adv_Lili.name: Lili Two-Bows
adv_Lili.notes: A companion of the exiled dragonangel. Mastered a unique technique to release arrows of longbows behind her back, because her arms are too short otherwise.

adv_Thoran.name: Thoran
adv_Thoran.notes: A companion of the exiled dragonangel. Natural leader, decended from royal family.

adv_Saint.name: Saint
adv_Saint.notes: The cheater anamoly, roaming the world laying waste and ruining the game.

Human.desc: The baseliner, short-lived and the minority in fantasy settings, yet capable of great deeds.

Barbarian.desc: Wildmen more of a humanoid than a human.

Dwarven.desc: A short sturdy race of industrious and greedy folk.

Elf.desc: Long lived race of fantasy folk decended from faeries.

Half-Elf.desc: Descended of a human and an elf.

Elfling.desc: Descended of a halfling and an elf.

Angel.desc: A divine being from the radiant realm.

Aasimar.desc: Love child of a human and an angel.

Warforged.desc: Mechanical conscience beings, built by engineers, chemists, and magic with a purpose.

Koboldog.desc: A mean humanoid akin to a large dog.

Direwolf.desc: Quad-pedal predator, more interested in nature than in adventures.

Trollkin.desc: Demihuman decendants of Trolls. Territorial, native to swamps and under bridges.

Halfling.desc: Small demihuman with affinity to nature and order.

Goon.desc: A more civilized and smaller Ogre. Good at boring tasks like guarding a spot.

Amazon.desc: A tribe of females shaped by their idol, the icon of a Valkyrie.

Carriagefarer.desc: the party's horse and buggy, builds the camp, cooks dinner, carries the loot, doesn't fight monsters.

Brute.desc: less proficient fighter, higher critical rate for recklessness.

Squire.desc: less proficient fighter on internship to become a Knight.

Baker.desc: A brute, higher critical rate for recklessness.

Miner.desc: A rogue with a day job. Like a thief, but less proficient

Bard.desc: The Jack of all trades, at your service!

Swordmage.desc: Elf specific class, a fighter proficient in spell casting.

Thief.desc: Rogue adept at indirect approach to challenges.

Spy.desc: Tactician adept at espionage and disguise, can pose as an alignment adjacent to their own, meaning neutral could pose as any.

Paladin.desc: The Divine Knight, sworn servitude to god, and to his king on the earthly realm.

Fallen Paladin.desc: A fighter, forsaken his oath but still has some providence.

Clericbot.desc: A warforged able to to channel divine power, but only partially, charging only healing abilities.

Deputy.desc: Halfling specific class. A fighter appointed to protect his community. Has some thieving skills.

Arcane Trickster.desc: Rogue adept in illusion and enchantment spells.

Shaman.desc: A mediator between the Material realm and the Spiritual realm.

Sorcerer.desc: A spellcaster with innate or inherited magical powers.

Druid.desc: A reverent of nature. Emissary to the wild.

Bouncer.desc: An unarmed brawler guarding a station, versed in striking and grappling.

Warlock.desc: Through a pact made with a supernatural power, the Warlock gains mysterious powers.

Huntress.desc: A female warrior adept at large wild game.

Green Knight.desc: A Paladin sworn to protect nature and wilderness.

Masochist.desc: Gain +1 Hit/Dmg for every 25% HP Missing.

Tunnel Surveyer.desc: Travel safely underground where cave-ins are bound.

Comedian.desc: Provides the party a moral boost. Comedian also preforms at the guild to entertain the patrons.

Scribe.desc: While idling at the guild writes magical scrolls.

Shady.desc: -2 Hit in fights, +2 Hit in Backstabs.

Independant.desc: Can travel alone, in a party of one.

Divine.desc: Has (10*Lvl) Radiant points to spend as Smite or Heal.

Holy Aura.desc: party has +1 hit and Save rolls.

Eternal.desc: If this patron happens to die, their body will disappear quickly and be Restored completely in their home realm, and return the next day.

Darkvision.desc: Can see in the darkness like in dim-lit, can see in dim-lit like in normal light.

Lightphobic.desc: +1 Hit in darkness , -1 Hit in normal light.

Apothecary.desc: While idling at the guild brews potions.

Faulty Powerpack.desc: While idling at the guild brews potions.

Immortal Protocol.desc: If taking any fatal damage, this Warforged can go dorment until it internally ressurects the vital processing unit.

Spinning Batter.desc: The Warforged may execute a powerful battering assault, spinning his body to attack the target 4 times in one round. The target has to be standing, and either grapped or dazed.

Healer.desc: Has (10*Lvl) Radiant points to spend as Heal.

Dorment.desc: This patron may not move or make any action. They can idle in the guild or be carried in a Carriage.

Adolescent.desc: Experience worse reactions with adults, but better reactions with children.

Postposed Death.desc: If this character takes fatal damage, even a catastophic dismemberment death, it may still act and attack for 2 rounds, with +4 to all rolls.

Game Hunter.desc: Have the Anatomical Expertise to subdue large beasts.

Tracker.desc: Tracks the footsteps of their target.

Extra proficiency.desc: Gains one more point of proficiency.

Trouble Makers.desc: While your party has a Barbarian, a Rogue, and a Bard, gaining better chances to succeed at work-arounds and made-up strategies in Encounters, rather than taking the forward approach or plain fighting.

Hogfamily First.desc: While your party contains family members, they gain +1 to all rolls

idleDesc.Bragain: Bragain can be assigned to a mining location, but he's currently enjoying his leisure time socializing and drinking.
idleDesc.Amyssa: Amyssa is focused on her scrolls scribing.
idleDesc.Claudio: The joyful Claudio is working the crowd, and playing his lute between sessions.
idleDesc.Hogperson: Hogperson is a pleasant company to be around.
idleDesc.Hogmother: Hogmother is a pleasant company to be around, always has an idea for a new batch.
idleDesc.Hogfather: The smell of yeast and baking fills the air of Hogfather's bakery. His mood is up and he's in his element.
idleDesc.Crusher: The Bouncer's watchful eye keeping everyone in order.
idleDesc.default: They possess unique qualities that set them apart.

traitReferrals.Tunnel Surveyer: As a Tunnel Surveyer, always keeping an eye structural integrity.
traitReferrals.Snob: Doesn't like to mingle with lower castes.
traitReferrals.Greedy: There's always a glint in their eyes, when money is involved.
traitReferrals.Comedian: Joyful, funny, a pleasure to have in your company.
traitReferrals.Calm: Expressions don't always need words around them.
traitReferrals.Apothecary: Often busy on a new batch.
traitReferrals.Persuasive: Always ready to hear your opinion and top it off with his own.
traitReferrals.Immune to Fear: Can face a wailing ghost that chills your bones without a blink.
traitReferrals.Armwrestler: Will take on anyone in counter-top Armwrestling.
traitReferrals.Unflappable: There isn't an insult in the lore that he haven't heard before already.
traitReferrals.Gardener: Really prefers to stay in his garden.
traitReferrals.Dark Ambition: Incredibly eerie, everyone's thoughs keep wondering in their presence.
traitReferrals.default: They possess unique qualities that set them apart.

hiringReferrals.Bragain: Bragain can be assigned to a mining location, but he's currently enjoying his leisure time socializing and drinking.
hiringReferrals.Amyssa: Amyssa is focused on her scrolls scribing.
hiringReferrals.Claudio: The joyful Claudio is working the crowd, and playing his lute between sessions.
hiringReferrals.Hogperson: The Cheerful Hogperson is a pleasant company to be around.
hiringReferrals.Crusher: Crusher is an experienced tavern bouncer, and will keep the peace in the inn. Or else.
hiringReferrals.Desmond: Experienced warrior, but carries a shrouded past and perhaps something more.
hiringReferrals.Tinman B-B-TR: The Warforged is a pleasant conversationalist, and is very wise.
hiringReferrals.default: They possess unique qualities that set them apart.

Large Club.name: Large Club
Large Club.desc: It was probably a foot of a table. A rather large table.

Iron Pick.name: Iron Pick
Iron Pick.desc: A pick's head fixed on a sturdy cane.

Knapsack.name: Knapsack
Knapsack.desc: Not very large, but can store gems.

Lute.name: Lute
Lute.desc: It sings as if it has a bird trapped inside.

Camp.name: Camp
Camp.desc: A kit that forms a makeshift cover.

Crusher's Favorite Mug.name: Crusher's Favorite Mug
Crusher's Favorite Mug.desc: A weathered tankard made of Oak and Tin, some etched inked markings on it give it a lot of character.
